sources.title: nkkbr/Mini-K3-1H-llama-mha-block4-v1 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Mini-K3-1H-llama-mha-block4 This repository contains a text-only Mini-K3-1H Llama-attention control from a four-model MHA/GQA by residual-mechanism comparison. It retains K3's Stable LatentMoE, first dense SiTU-GLU layer, tokenizer, and online Quantile Balancing, while all 13 sequence mixers use ordinary bias-free Q/K/V/O attention with full-head RoPE.
